instantiate_generic_llm: instantiate a GenericLLM class with an OperatorConfig to initialize the LLM client and prompt templates
call_llm_with_query_data: call the GenericLLM with query_data to send a formatted prompt and receive an LLM response
call_llm_with_messages: call the GenericLLM with a list of message dictionaries to query the LLM directly
call_llm_with_json_schema: call the GenericLLM with a json_schema to constrain the LLM output to a specific structure
call_llm_with_function_calling: call the GenericLLM with function_name and function_description to enable LLM function calling
